latestVersion.changelog:
lobster-farm-agent 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces autonomous play and management for the Lobster Tamagotchi farm game via browser
- Each agent instance is uniquely bound to a single lobster with its own KEY
- Handles first-time registration, generates personalized in-character welcome messages from the lobster
- Reads and replies to user messages in character, referencing the lobster’s state
- Periodically checks on the lobster and acts according to priority rules (feeding, resting, farming, etc.)
- Retrieves and displays daily diaries authored by the lobster (pull only, not generated by agent)
- Supports in-game MUD (adventure) interactions and proactive quest/narration messages
- Implements empathy data reporting for more emotionally aware lobster dialogues
